purpose: Native end-to-end feasibility pilot, not full-suite or method reproduction

acceptance: real raw model events match saved prediction and executed action
replay all official transitions and reward without LLM calls
positive and negative official scorer controls
all selected tasks retained including failures
runner_revision: webshop/runner: fix serialization of JSON search/click arguments
setup_failure: results/setup_failed_action_encoding retained; not a valid performance run; task indices and budget unchanged
